utilities.cn: import { clsx, type ClassValue } from 'clsx'; import { twMerge } from 'tailwind-merge'; export function cn(...inputs: ClassValue[]) { return twMerge(clsx(inputs)); }

notes: Generate components.json at project root with these settings.
Create src/lib/utils.ts with the cn() utility function.
Add components via: npx shadcn@latest add <component>.
For SvelteKit use shadcn-svelte. For Vue use shadcn-vue. Adjust imports accordingly.
The new-york style uses smaller radius and tighter spacing — preferred for professional apps.
